description: This file defines the MembershipsRepository class, which provides methods for managing and querying membership data related to organizations and users, using Prisma ORM within a NestJS application.

classes.name: MembershipsRepository
classes.description: Repository class for handling membership-related database operations.

methods.name: findOrgUserMembership
methods.description: Finds a user's membership in an organization by organization ID and user ID.

methods.name: findPlatformOwnerUserId
methods.description: Retrieves the user ID of the platform owner for a given organization.

methods.name: findPlatformAdminUserId
methods.description: Retrieves the user ID of the platform admin for a given organization.

methods.name: findMembershipByTeamId
methods.description: Finds a membership by team ID and user ID.

methods.name: findUserMemberships
methods.description: Retrieves all memberships for a specific user.

methods.name: findMembershipByOrgId
methods.description: Alias for findMembershipByTeamId, finds membership by organization ID and user ID.

methods.name: isUserOrganizationAdmin
methods.description: Checks if a user is an admin or owner of an organization.

methods.name: getOrgIdsWhereUserIsAdminOrOwner
methods.description: Gets organization IDs where the user is an admin or owner.

methods.name: getUserAdminOrOwnerTeamMembership
methods.description: Retrieves a user's admin or owner membership in a specific team.

methods.name: getUserMembershipInOneOfOrgs
methods.description: Finds a user's membership in one of the specified organizations.

methods.name: getUserMembershipInOneOfOrgsTeams
methods.description: Finds a user's membership in teams under specified organizations.
